newsitem.title: UK: Greenalls profits in line with targets.
newsitem.headline: Greenalls profits in line with targets.

text.p: UK pubs to off-licences group Greenalls Group Plc said on Friday that pretax profits before exceptionals for the year to date were in line with expectations and significantly ahead of the same time last year.
Greenalls said in a trading statement current pretax profits covering the 11 months to the end of August reflected its 518 million stg acquisition of Boddington Group Plc last November.

The group noted that although the summmer weather was not as good as last year, the pub and branded restaurant businesses had traded well and individual outlets were ahead of the same year ago period.
Accommodation businesses also saw revenues well up on last year after a busy summer, Greenalls added.

"The results for the year to date have been achieved through both the rapid absorption of Boddington in line with our planned timetable and a good trading performance from the former Boddington and existing Greenalls' businesses," the firm said.
Greenalls said synergies of at least 18 million stg would be achieved in the first 12 months after buying Boddington.

Reorganisation and integration costs remained in line with budget and the acquisition was not expected to result in any dilution of earnings per share before exceptional items this year. It would enhance earnings from the next financial year, the company added.
